reason: The 2024 ACS includes the required women-to-men earnings ratio concept, but this pass did not retrieve Monterey County's county estimate. No value was reconstructed from separate median earnings because source-specific universes and rounding could alter the ratio.
nearest_data: Opened Census API metadata for ACS 2024 table S2002: https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5/subject/groups/S2002.html. It defines the women's earnings percentage of men's earnings measure and its worker universes; the metadata page contains no county estimate.
